answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism where each vertex in the network must anchor its identity to a unique biometric beacon. By requiring a costly, verified physical presence at a designated wharf to participate in the economy, the system forces attackers to incur linear costs for each additional identity. Since creating fake agents requires expensive, non-scalable human verification, the cost of subverting consensus via account flooding exceeds any potential profit.
